bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
src=82c02b1e85fa7749ddaa3f50d879ea88795778a3
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo STK04_FETCH_FAILED; exit 61; }
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$src" || { echo STK04_SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH; exit 62; }
target="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/sticker-poll-$src"
mkdir -p "$target"
chmod 700 "$target"
git archive "$src" | tar -xf - -C "$target"
test -f "$target/src/runtime/main.mjs" && test -f "$target/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs" || { echo STK04_STAGED_SOURCE_MISSING; exit 63; }
grep -Fq 'COPY --chown=node:node src ./src' "$target/deploy/Dockerfile" || exit 64
! grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*user:' "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" || exit 65
build_log="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-vdobot-fixed.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -f "$build_log"' EXIT
if ! docker build --no-cache --network host --pull=false -f "$target/deploy/Dockerfile" -t create-videobot:poll-fixed "$target" >"$build_log" 2>&1;then
 echo STK04_FIXED_IMAGE_BUILD_FAILED
 grep -Ei 'failed|error|timeout' "$build_log" | tail -n 4 | sed -E 's#https?://[^ ]+#URL_REDACTED#g' || true
 exit 66
fi
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint /bin/sh create-videobot:poll-fixed -c \
 'test -f /opt/videobot/src/runtime/main.mjs && test -f /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs && test -d /opt/videobot/node_modules/pg' >/dev/null || { echo STK04_FIXED_IMAGE_READ_FAILED; exit 67; }
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint node create-videobot:poll-fixed -e \
 "import('./src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs').then(()=>process.exit(0)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))" >/dev/null || { echo STK04_FIXED_IMAGE_IMPORT_FAILED; exit 68; }
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Config.User}}' create-videobot:poll-fixed)" = node || exit 69
echo STK04_NONROOT_IMAGE_IMPORT=PASS
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
docker inspect "$name" >/dev/null || exit 70
token="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$name")"
dbpass="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$name")"
test -f "$token" && test -f "$dbpass" || exit 71
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 72
user="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'printf %s "$POSTGRES_USER"')"
net="$(docker inspect -f '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $k}}{{end}}' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d')"
test -n "$user" && test "$net" = deploy_default || exit 73
other="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'create-videobot|createvdobot|videobot-poll|videobot-telegram' | grep -Fxv "$name" || true)"
test -z "$other" || { echo STK04_DUPLICATE_CONSUMER; exit 74; }
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="$token" VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$dbpass" GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$user" GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK="$net"
docker image tag create-videobot:local-poll create-videobot:poll-rollback
docker image tag create-videobot:poll-fixed create-videobot:local-poll
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo STK04_FIXED_RECREATE_FAILED; exit 75; }
sleep 10
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" = true || { echo STK04_FIXED_NOT_RUNNING; exit 76; }
docker logs --tail 100 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' || { echo STK04_FIXED_NOT_READY; exit 77; }
echo STK04_DM_POLL_READY=PASS
docker logs --tail 100 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -E '^CREATOR_(DM|GATE|POLL)_' | tail -n 8 || true
